WebUi.Settings.Title: Web interface
WebUi.Settings.Status.PortInUse: Not running: port {0} is used by another program. Choose another port below.
WebUi.Settings.LinkHint: The link contains a secret key. Anyone who has it can open your library on this computer, so do not share it.
WebUi.Settings.PortHint: A number from 1024 to 65535. Change it only if another program already uses this one.
WebUi.Settings.ResetHint: Creates a new secret key. Links you opened or copied before stop working.
WebUi.Settings.ResetConfirmText: Browser tabs and copied links that use the old link stop working. Open the web interface from here again afterwards.
WebUi.Settings.ResetDone: A new access link was created.
WebUi.Error.PortInUse: The web interface could not start: port {0} is used by another program. Choose another port in Settings → Web interface.
WebUi.Error.OpenBrowser: The browser could not be opened. Use “Copy link” and paste the link into your browser.
WebUi.Error.Clipboard: The link could not be copied. Try again.
WebUi.Web.OpenFromApp: Open the web interface from Magpienest: Settings → Web interface → Open in browser.
WebUi.Settings.Status.Certificate: Not running: HTTPS is on but the certificate cannot be used. Choose the certificate file again or switch HTTPS off.
WebUi.Settings.Access.Home: This computer and devices on your home network (same Wi-Fi)
WebUi.Settings.Access.InternetHint: For the internet you also have to forward the port on your router. A private network app such as Tailscale is a safer way to reach your library from outside: it needs no open port, and its devices count as your home network.
WebUi.Settings.RequirePassword: Require the password on the home network
WebUi.Settings.RequirePasswordHint: When off, anyone on your Wi-Fi can open your library without signing in. From the internet the password is always required.
WebUi.Settings.Tailscale: Treat Tailscale devices as home network
WebUi.Settings.TailscaleHint: Addresses from 100.64.0.0 to 100.127.255.255, used by Tailscale and similar private network apps.
WebUi.Settings.Firewall: The first time, Windows Firewall may ask whether Magpienest may use the network. Allow it for private networks; otherwise other devices cannot connect.
WebUi.Settings.PasswordSet: A password is set. Other devices sign in with it once and are then remembered for 30 days.
WebUi.Settings.PasswordNotSet: No password is set yet. It is needed before other devices can sign in.
WebUi.Settings.PasswordSaved: Password saved. Devices that were signed in have to sign in again.
WebUi.Settings.OtherDevices: Open on your phone or another device
WebUi.Settings.OtherDevicesHint: Scan a code with the phone's camera, or type the address into its browser. The device must be on the same network as this computer.
WebUi.Settings.NoAddress: This computer has no home-network address right now. Check that it is connected to your network.
WebUi.Settings.InternetHint: For access from the internet, forward TCP port {0} on your router to {1}. How to do that depends on your router; look for “port forwarding” in its settings.
WebUi.Settings.InternetText: Anyone on the internet will be able to reach the sign-in page, and programs that guess passwords will try. Your library stays protected by your password and an encrypted connection (HTTPS), which cannot be switched off in this mode. You also have to forward port {0} on your router yourself.
WebUi.Settings.HttpsHint: Protects the password and your library on the way between the devices.
WebUi.Settings.Https.Automatic: On, with a certificate made by Magpienest
WebUi.Settings.HttpsForced: Access from the internet is on, so HTTPS is used with a certificate made by Magpienest.
WebUi.Settings.AutomaticHint: Browsers do not know this certificate, so each device warns once that the connection is not private. Choose to continue anyway (for example “Advanced” → “Continue”).
WebUi.Settings.RenewText: Devices will warn about the certificate once more. Use this when this computer's network address changed.
WebUi.Settings.SignOutAllText: Every device has to sign in again with the password.
WebUi.Settings.ExtraHostsHint: Only needed if you reach this computer by a name of your own (for example nas.example.com) without a password. Separate names with commas.
WebUi.Password.Hint: Use at least 8 characters. Other devices sign in with this password.
WebUi.Password.Mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
WebUi.Password.CertificateHint: Type the password of the certificate file.
WebUi.Error.Certificate: The certificate could not be used. Check the file and its password.
WebUi.Error.SignInPaused: Many wrong passwords were typed into the web interface. Signing in is paused for 15 minutes. If this was not you, consider changing the password.
WebUi.Web.SignIn.TooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in {0} minutes.
WebUi.Web.SignIn.NoPassword: No password is set. Set one in Magpienest: Settings → Web interface.
WebUi.Web.SignIn.Failed: Could not sign in. Check the connection and try again.
WebUi.Page.Title: Web
WebUi.Page.NoRuntime: The Web page needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which could not be started on this PC. You can still open the web interface in your browser.
WebUi.Page.NotRunning: The web interface is not running. Check Settings → Web interface.
WebUi.Settings.ShowPage: Show the Web page in the navigation
WebUi.Settings.PasswordOffTitle: Turn off the password at home?
WebUi.Settings.PasswordOffText: Anyone connected to your home Wi-Fi, guests included, will be able to open and change your library in a browser without signing in. Devices on the internet still need the password.
WebUi.Web.Empty: Nothing here. Try other filters, or add a folder in Magpienest.
WebUi.Web.Details.Title: Details
WebUi.Web.Details.Missing: The file is missing. It may have been moved or its drive is not connected.
WebUi.Web.Error.Load: Could not load. Check the connection and try again.
WebUi.Web.Error.NotFound: This item is no longer in the library.
WebUi.Web.Player.CannotPlay: This video format cannot be played in the browser — open it in Magpienest.
WebUi.Web.Reader.CoverAloneOff: Cover paired with the next page
WebUi.Web.Sort.Label: Sort by
WebUi.Web.Sort.Title: Title
WebUi.Web.Viewer.CannotShow: This image cannot be shown in the browser.
